workload.generalization_limit: Repeated fixed prompt may benefit from prefix caching; not a representative news/research corpus.

metadata.arrival_pattern: closed-loop: at most N in-flight requests; replacement on completion
metadata.measurement_scope: client end-to-end non-streaming response including queueing, network and schema validation

metric_definitions.attempted_requests: Every dispatched driver request, including connection failures and timeouts.
metric_definitions.successful_requests: HTTP 200 with valid JSON, matching model, valid envelope and sentiment schema.
metric_definitions.elapsed_seconds: Wall-clock stage span, including failed attempts and final outstanding completion.
metric_definitions.tokens: Only backend-reported input/output token usage; missing values remain unknown, never estimated.
metric_definitions.latency: Per-attempt dispatch to completed response/error; no omitted failures in all-attempt quantiles.
metric_definitions.warmup: Separate sequential stage; excluded from measured-stage throughput and latency summaries.
metric_definitions.limits: Bounded request count/concurrency, no redirects/retries, full exchange timeout and 1 MiB response cap.

provenance.interpretation: Observed HTTP endpoint workload. Backend/model-info values are declarations; GPU execution and deployment require separate observed evidence.
